steps.note: B1.1 states that the target changes by (JV+RG)x independently of the initial side and central values, and B1's method says the last two rows restore the scratch wires, matching the paper.

B1.2 only says the side injection cancels 'the intersection-count coefficient for neighbouring triples' for both cases at once; it never gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 or says that the side wires cancel exactly the intersection-one cases.
The plan never treats the complex case separately: the central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the side wires cancelling intersections zero and two are not stated anywhere.
B1.3 gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and B1 states that every scratch wire is returned to its initial value.

B3's method only names 'tabulate the orthogonal residual of every edge', and B3.5 says that edges join comparable labels; apart from the central loss P(x)F of dimension h, none of the per-edge residuals or their dimensions are given.
B3.1 notes that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal, but the side edge 2->5, the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp and the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 never appear.
The plan gives the only decreasing edges as the central 3->4 edges with loss h, telescoping at the gates with sources N and sinks Wm-N, the signed total Wm-2N and the absolute total Wm-2N+2L.

B6 and B6.1 use an orthonormal residual basis without justifying it; the F2 argument that every nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating, and the absorption of alternating planes, is missing.
B4.3 gives only L_b/N=100/539; the complex ratio L_c/N=101/539 is never stated (B6.3 gives only the deficit 2N-2L_c>0), so half of the sub-step is missing.

B6.1 states that orthogonal binary vectors have even support intersection, so weight is additive mod 4, and that the phase change over an orthonormal residual basis is a sum of weight terms, a faithful paraphrase of q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v.x].
B6.2 gives odd weight, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} with its explicit decomposition, and H diag(1,-1) H = X turning it into aI+bX_v or its inverse.

B6 and B6.3 count s_c kernels in all, B6.5 extends to any number of columns by tensor products, and D3 (paper line 1906) states that the network with column frames gives exactly s_c child calls, each on one slot's axes.

B6.4 gives C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) for the exceptional pair, repaired by C=iZC^{-1}Z with sign corrections at source and sink, and B6.5 negates the X outputs; the plan does not explicitly state the endpoint frames I (zero label) and C^{tensor m} (full label).
B4 and B4.3 state that L/N=100/539<1/2 so N-2L>0, B4.5 gives s=Wm-N+2L with deficit N-2L>0 so s<Wm, and B6.3 gives the complex deficit.
B7.1 says only that eta_b exceeds 20*2^-50; the exact value 339/22587335000000 is never given.
B7.1 says only that eta_c exceeds 20*2^-50; the exact value 73/19906842167500 is never given.
B7.1-B7.3 state that both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, that m<2^20 gives m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), and that s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.

C1 asserts the factorization A=E1 Pi E2 with exactly a ones (and the A=0 case) but gives none of the elimination proof: no topmost-row rightmost-entry pivot, lower-triangular clearing or repetition on active indices.
C2 works over Z/q^b Z but never says how the fixed odd prime q is chosen to avoid every denominator in the finite table of factors so that the triangular factors stay invertible.
C2.1 states that a lower-triangular transformation of H or D costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order with controlled shifts.
C2.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, the swap and D_j<-H_i-D_j with one interchange per one of Pi, and C2 gives exactly a interchanges in all.
D11 cites only ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) and H1.1 quotes C_1=20; the constants E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu=11, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and C_0=128mB^2 are never defined.
The plan has no arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with leaf bound 8e; D7 is the time recurrence, not this one.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, the bound A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} and the total below C_0 d^{C_1} are absent.

D11 asserts the result (growth bounded by ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p), exact in O(p) bits) without the depth-l induction to 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^l, the p+Delta and Delta+3 bit reservation, or the condition epsilon C_1<1.

D states the truncation error below sqrt2 2^-p, and E3.2 calls H a contraction in the transform rounds (line 2914), but the plan never gives the absolute row sum one of H, the preservation of disks or the componentwise truncation argument in the layer proof.

summary: P01 is complete on the scalar-motif algebra (B1, B4), on telescoping the label dimensions (L3), on the phase interface (P1-P4), on the qualitative rank saving and its exponent (R1, R4), and on the triangular-factor cost and pivot interchanges (M3, M4). It omits the bit and complex coefficient cases (B2, B3), the residual table, the side edge and the F2 orthonormal-basis argument (L1, L2, L4), the complex loss ratio (L5), the exact deficits (R2, R3), the elimination proof and the choice of prime (M1, M2), and the whole guard-width derivation of the simultaneous layer (S1-S5), whose results D and D11 assert without the sub-steps. 11 of 26 present, 0 wrong.
